title: Tor against A/I^n of a finite module over a Noetherian ring is strictly pro-zero (Stacks 0911)
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $M$ a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. For $n\ge m\ge0$ let $\operatorname{Tor}^A_p(M,A/I^n)\to\operatorname{Tor}^A_p(M,A/I^m)$ be the map induced [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules] by the quotient map $A/I^n\to A/I^m$ (with $I^0=A$). Then for every $p>0$ there exists an integer $c>0$ such that the map $\operatorname{Tor}^A_p(M,A/I^n)\to\operatorname{Tor}^A_p(M,A/I^{n-c})$ is zero for all $n\ge c$.

The free module is finite, so K is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-submodule-finite]. This requires only a finite free presentation, not an infinite finite free resolution.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-tor-long-exact-first-variable] to K → R^t → X. Since the middle module is projective, Mathlib isZero_Tor'_succ_of_projective and exactness make the boundary δ_N : Tor_1(X,N) → K tensor N injective, naturally in N. Using [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-over-quotient-ring], represent δ_(R/J)(z) by k tensor 1. Exactness at K tensor R/J says k lies in J R^t, and k is already in K. If J R^t intersect K ≤ J' K, then Submodule.mem_smul_top_iff identifies k with an element of J' times top in K. Tensor/quotient equivalence kills k tensor 1 modulo J'; boundary naturality and injectivity force Tor_1(X,R/J → R/J') = 0. This is the proved private helper tor_one_reduction_zero.

Set c = max c0 1 > 0. For n ≥ c, monotonicity gives I^n top intersect K ≤ I^(n-c0) K ≤ I^(n-c) K. Step 2 with J = I^n and J' = I^(n-c) proves the degree-one case, including n=c.

proof.text: Induct on positive p, uniformly over all finite modules X in the universe of R. The degree-one case is Step 3. For p ≥ 1, form the short exact sequence K → R^t → X from Step 1. Apply the proved natural dimension-shift theorem [lem-sc-p1-tor-dimension-shift-natural] to obtain Tor_(p+1)(X,N) ≅ Tor_p(K,N), natural in N. The inductive hypothesis applies to the finite module K and gives a single c > 0 uniformly in n. Naturality expresses the higher transition composed with the target isomorphism as the source isomorphism composed with the zero transition. Cancel the target isomorphism to obtain zero. This is the proved private helper tor_pow_zero_same_universe.

proof.text: For the original universe-polymorphic statement take R = ULift A, J = I.map ULift.ringEquiv.symm.toRingHom, and X = ULift M. Noetherianity and finiteness transfer along the ring equivalence, using Mathlib isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv and Module.Finite.of_surjective. Ideal.map_pow and Ideal.quotientEquiv give explicit R-linear equivalences e_n : R/J^n ≃ ULift (A/I^n). On every quotient generator the square between the ordinary transition and the displayed conjugated reduction commutes by reflexivity. Map the square through Tor and cancel its source isomorphism to transfer Step 4's vanishing. All universe lifts and the public signature are unchanged.
